item.title: SKADI 1.0.0-beta.24
item.description:
SKADI 1.0.0-beta.24 — Discover, Watch Together and Plex friends

Built by the coordinated release factory from one tag: Windows, Linux, LG webOS and the Android TV beta APK on GitHub, plus the Fire OS APK for Amazon Live App Testing.

Main changes

  • Discover (desktop, Android TV / Fire OS, webOS): the plex.tv catalog, with:
  • Plex rails and catalog sheets;
  • trailers in the SKADI player;
  • your streaming services;
  • the watchlist synced with your plex.tv account.

A title one of your servers has opens in your library.

  • Watch Together through the SKADI relay (desktop, Android TV / Fire OS, webOS): rooms with a code, and the TV can host or join. The current relay is a test deployment.
  • Plex friends (read only):
  • « Avis de tes amis » on Plex movie and series pages;
  • « Activité des amis » in Discover.
  • Player:
  • seek preview pictures (Plex BIF thumbnails, Jellyfin trickplay) on webOS and Android TV / Fire OS;
  • a subtitle delay on webOS.
  • Google TV / Android TV: SKADI's « Continuer » row appears in the home screen's « Continuer à regarder ».
  • webOS:
  • « Qui regarde ? » at launch;
  • a stronger focus ring and the full title on the focused card;
  • text sizes harmonized on search, detail, library and settings pages.
  • Recently added episodes are grouped like Plex, and empty, offline and failure states were redesigned.
  • Full details in CHANGELOG.md.

Version and distribution

  • Product version 1.0.0-beta.24, build 58; webOS package version 1.0.58.
  • Android versionCode 58, strictly greater than beta.23 (57). Identifier com.skadi.client and release signing unchanged.
  • GitHub release (arthoriouss/skadi-releases):
  • Windows installer and portable ZIP;
  • Linux .deb, .tar.gz, .rpm and Flatpak;
  • webOS IPK;
  • Android TV beta APK;
  • release-index.json and SHA256SUMS.txt.

Windows updates through WinSparkle (appcast.xml).

  • Fire OS: the private Actions artifact skadi-fireos-amazon-v1.0.0-beta.24 (APK) is uploaded by hand to Amazon Live App Testing, as a new version of the existing test.
  • Google Play (Android TV):
  • The store AAB is built locally with scripts/windows/build-android-tv-release.ps1 (production channel, com.skadi.client) and uploaded to the internal testing track.
  • The factory APK is the sideload beta (com.skadi.client.beta).

Qualification and limits

  • The webOS IPK is the sideload package; LG Content Store submission stays manual.
  • Plex friends' reviews and activity use plex.tv's unofficial community API. If plex.tv changes it, the sections hide themselves.
  • The Watch Together relay runs on a test domain until the final one is set up.
